en.t: It was a late night in autumn.

units.source_text: 在南京奇望街的一栋房子里，有一个中国少女正坐在简陋老旧的桌子旁边，

en.t: In a house on Qiwang Street in Nanjing, a Chinese girl was sitting beside a plain, old table,

units.source_text: 她面色苍白，以手托腮，无聊的磕着盘子里瓜子。

en.t: her face pale, her cheek propped in her hand, idly cracking the melon seeds on the plate.
